Your favorite cabin will be parked right in your driveway. Whether you’re in the driver’s
seat or a lucky passenger, FIAT® 500X surrounds you with everything you need, right at
your fingertips. The 3.5-inch reconfigurable Electronic Vehicle Information Center clearly
displays everything from safety and security alerts to fuel usage to Dynamic Selector
data. The large 7-inch touchscreen display is vivid and intuitive with advanced graphics that
enhance available navigation, radio control and more … while clever storage solutions help
you keep track of everything you bring along.

10 DESIGN PERFORMANCE SAFETY & SECURITY TECHNOLOGY COMFORT & CONVENIENCE SPECIFICATIONS
SELECTIVE
S T E E R I N G
The FIAT® Dynamic Selector Traction Control System puts
three customized driving modes at your fingertips:
AUTO MODE is designed for the everyday, routine
stuff — it will smooth things out to help optimize fuel
efficiency, emissions and comfort.
SPORT MODE is for those who’d prefer spirited
performance with a little more road feel. With it, the
Electronic Stability Control4 and steering calibrations are
tuned for a sportier feel and quicker driving response.
Additionally, Sport Mode optimizes the transmission shift
points for maximized performance and accelerator feedback.
TRACTION+ MODE maximizes low-speed traction — the
kind you need when things get a little slick or bumpy. It all
works by providing additional wheel-slip through specially
tuned chassis controls and a more direct engine response.

13 DESIGN PERFORMANCE SAFETY & SECURITY TECHNOLOGY COMFORT & CONVENIENCE SPECIFICATIONS
STARTING WITH A STRONG UNIBODY STRUCTURE THAT IS CONSTRUCTED
WITH HIGH-STRENGTH STEEL, FIAT® 500X OFFERS OVER 70 STANDARD
AND AVAILABLE SAFETY AND SECURITY FEATURES THAT INFORM EVERY
PART OF ITS DESIGN AND OPERATION.
FULL-SPEED FORWARD COLLISION WARNING WITH ACTIVE BRAKING7
O V E R
This system uses radar sensors to detect when you may be approaching another vehicle
too rapidly. It readies the brakes and alerts you with visual and audible warnings when it
senses a potential frontal impact. If you do not respond, the brakes can bring the vehicle
to a full stop. Standard.
LANESENSE® LANE DEPARTURE WARNING WITH LANE KEEP ASSIST1
Tracks the vehicle’s lane position via a mounted camera, alerting the driver with a
visual warning if the vehicle is drifting outside the marked lane. Also provides corrective
steering input to encourage the driver to keep within lane boundaries. Standard.
BLIND SPOT MONITORING8 AND REAR CROSS-PATH DETECTION2 SYSTEMS
These features use sensors to constantly monitor the space between you and other
vehicles, assisting you when changing lanes. They alert you to traffic in your vehicle’s
blind-spot zones with an illuminated icon in the corresponding exterior mirror. In parking
lot situations, they warn drivers who are backing out of parking spaces with visual and
audible alerts of lateral traffic. Standard.
7 STANDARD AIR BAGS9
Front-seat-mounted side, full-length side, driver’s knee bolster and advanced multistage
front air bags9 all work together, providing protection.
